description: The layers every source file belongs to (endpoint, handler, service, DB service, util, constants/types), the dependency direction between them, why an endpoint may never call a service, why direction decides the layer (pushed in → endpoint, pulled from outside → service triggered by an endpoint), why a handler never touches storage, why everything takes and returns objects, and the hard rules: composition over inheritance, single responsibility, reusability, and no .ts file over 150 lines.

How the app/ UI is built: pages, layouts, components and composables, the rule that app/ never imports server/ and reaches it only through /api, Neo-Brutalism UI snippets (copy-paste Tailwind HTML from neo-brutalism-ui-library.vercel.app) ported into app/components/ui/ as Nb* components, and the palette/shadow tokens in app/assets/css/main.css.

What dgtest is built and checked with: bun installs, Nuxt 4 builds and serves (Nitro server, Vite client), Tailwind v4 via @tailwindcss/vite, the bun run dev/build/check/lint/fmt/test commands and what fails each, @nuxt/eslint with stylistic formatting, the 150-line gate over .ts and .vue, bun test with node:assert (tests written and run only when the user asks), runtimeConfig and NUXT_* env vars, and the invariants.

The documentation standard: .ref.md vs .flow.md vs .doc.md, feature-level scope, the strict split, the shape of each file, mermaid rules (one diagram per phase, autonumber, every node names its file,
not \n), Key rules / Invariants, and keeping this directory true.

What the DGT practice feature is made of: the flat 766-question bank (server/assets/questions.json), the SQLite users and tests tables (q1…q30 JSON slots {question, answer?}, is_completed, total_answered, total_errors, elapsed_seconds, resumed_at; legacy table dropped on open), the localStorage user id, the ten /api routes (create-user, start-test, attempt, test-answer, undo-answer, resume-test, pause-test, finish-test, my-tests, started-tests) with params and errors, the pages and their routes, NUXT_DB_PATH, and invariants (reveal only after answering, answer once (a wrong one may be undone), complete at 30 answers or 30 min of open-page time, blank = error, pass ≤ 3 errors, tests never translated).

How a practice session moves: anonymous user creation on first mount, starting a test (30 random questions stored as a row that holds the clock), answering one question at a time with instant green/red grading on the server, undoing a wrong pick, the clock pausing when the page is left and resuming when reopened, closing on timeout (server-checked, blanks become errors), and reading back My tests and the review.
